Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class EditorTheme

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.EditorTheme
public final class EditorTheme extends Object
An immutable colour scheme for the editor: the chrome colours (background, text, caret, selection, gutter, current line, bracket match) plus one colour per TokenKind. Two themes ship built in — LIGHT and DARK — selected by name through byName(java.lang.String); extensions can construct their own.
